hook.name: HookdRandomHook
hook.description: A reusable Uniswap v4 hook that records a rolling random seed per ERC3232 token after each pool swap. In afterSwap, it updates lastSeed[token] using a keccak256 hash of the prior seed, swap parameters, and block data, enabling ERC3232 token contracts to derive randomness for object generation without the hook itself minting anything.
